title: Stacked duplicate objects
description: Layout-quality rule — two sibling objects of the same type share exactly the same bounds. The upper one fully covers the other, typically a double paste. Tab and popover panels are excluded (congruent by design).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Two congruent objects of the same type almost always mean a double paste. The upper object swallows clicks meant for the lower one, and edits hit whichever is selected by accident.
rule.remediation: Delete one of the two objects, or offset them deliberately if both are needed.
